title: Embrace of the Elements
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · Embrace of the Elements · A1:H60 · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit#gid=1052333103

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 11cost
Tier 22cost
Tier 33cost
Theme 1

The Frostbound

Tier 1Cost 1

When you hit with a melee attack, add an extra 2 cold damage per damage die rolled.

Full original wording

You are the breath before death—the chill that settles in the bones before the end. When you hit with a melee attack, add an extra 2 cold damage per damage die rolled.

Tier 2Cost 2

Gain resistance to cold damage. When you take cold damage, you can use your reaction to have immunity till the end of your next turn.

Full original wording

Your blood does not slow, your breath does not freeze. Chill is powerless in your presence. Gain resistance to cold damage. When you take cold damage, you can use your reaction to have immunity till the end of your next turn.

Tier 3Cost 3

Once per long rest, cause ice to cover the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on yourself as a bonus action. Enemies must make a Dexterity save (DC = 8 + proficiency + Dexterity modifier) or fall prone and have their speed halved until the start of your next turn. Your movement is not hindered by slippery surfaces. The ice lasts for 10 minutes or until subjected to fire. It extinguishes non-magical flames when it is first summoned.

Full original wording

You call upon the cold not as an enemy, but as an old friend—it wraps around you, waiting to strike at your command. Once per long rest, cause ice to cover the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on yourself as a bonus action. Enemies must make a Dexterity save (DC = 8 + proficiency + Dexterity modifier) or fall prone and have their speed halved until the start of your next turn. Your movement is not hindered by slippery surfaces. The ice lasts for 10 minutes or until subjected to fire. It extinguishes non-magical flames when it is first summoned.

Theme 2

The Mistwalker

Tier 1Cost 1

You see what lies beyond the mist’s shroud, eyes unclouded by nature’s disguises. The mist serves you. While within 60 feet of fog, mist, and other water based obscurment no longer reduces your vision.

Full original wording

You see what lies beyond the mist’s shroud, eyes unclouded by nature’s disguises. The mist serves you. While within 60 feet of fog, mist, and other water based obscurment no longer reduces your vision.

Tier 2Cost 2

Once per long rest, cast gaseous form on yourself without using a spell slot or components.

Full original wording

The world’s solidity loosens around you—your body passing through obstacles as if they were mist. Once per long rest, cast gaseous form on yourself without using a spell slot or components.

Tier 3Cost 3

A number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you can use your bonus action to teleport up to 30 feet to a point you can see.

Full original wording

Enemies strike at shadows and air, their blows passing through your mist-cloaked body without effect. A number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you can use your bonus action to teleport up to 30 feet to a point you can see.

Theme 3

The Stormrider

Tier 1Cost 1

Gain a 10-foot bonus to your movement speed during your turn.

Full original wording

You dart across the battlefield with a blur, lightning-fast and deadly in every motion. Gain a 10-foot bonus to your movement speed during your turn.

Tier 2Cost 2

Gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage

Full original wording

You are the eye of the storm—calm, fierce, and utterly unstoppable. Gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage

Tier 3Cost 3

Once per short rest, you become a bolt of lightning. Each round, you may forfeit your movement to move up to double your movement as a 5 foot wide straight line. You may move through creatures spaces as if they were difficult terrain, but cannot move through objects. * Each creature in this line must make a DC 15 Dex save, on a failure take 4d6 lightning damage, on a success, take half. You may make a number of jumps equal to your proficiency bonus, or if you move in a form other than that of the lightning bolts

Full original wording

The storm rages within you—thunder in your voice, lightning in your strike, and wind in your step. Once per short rest, you become a bolt of lightning. Each round, you may forfeit your movement to move up to double your movement as a 5 foot wide straight line. You may move through creatures spaces as if they were difficult terrain, but cannot move through objects. * Each creature in this line must make a DC 15 Dex save, on a failure take 4d6 lightning damage, on a success, take half. You may make a number of jumps equal to your proficiency bonus, or if you move in a form other than that of the lightning bolts
